answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit of onyx tokens to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work puzzle seeded by their identity plus a random walnut nonce published by the network. Duplicate identities collapse into one because the nonce binds work to a single key. Faking a thousand sybils means paying a thousand deposits and repeating the work, creating a cost ripple that honest single agents never feel.
